newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end weaker, EDP bucks trend.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end weaker, EDP bucks trend.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended weaker, although they recovered from the sharp correction in the afternoon following the release of disappointing May inflation data. The market's attention will continue to focus on privatised utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal tomorrow after the share showed strong gains in heavy volume in its first day of trade. Dealers said EDP could edge higher as institutional investors continued to fill their portfolios with stocks they did not obtain in the heavily oversubscribed sell-off. However, other Lisbon stocks could follow the negative sentiment seen in other European bourses. Futures on three-month Lisbor and the PSI-20 index of 20 leading stocks hit a record on the Oporto Derivatives Exchange (BDP) today.
